pots.title: Pots
pots.noMoss: Your herbarium is empty for now: cross level 2 to collect your first moss, then plant it here.
pots.hint: Each potted moss adds to the yield by rarity: common 2, uncommon 3, rare 5, very rare 8 dew per task. Empty pots add nothing. A moss stays in your herbarium while potted, and swapping is free.

plant.emptyHint: Complete tasks to cross level 2: each level brings a moss to your herbarium.

facilities.title: Facilities

glasshouse.name: Glasshouse
glasshouse.description: One more pot per level, so more mosses feed the yield

misters.name: Misters
misters.description: +10% yield per level, which grows every task’s bonus

rain_barrel.name: Rain barrel
rain_barrel.description: Raises the watering multiplier by 1 per level: bigger bonus on Plant tasks, half of it on Water tasks
rain_barrel.upgradeTo: Upgrade the Rain barrel to level {level}

facilities.hint: Upgrades are instant and permanent. The glasshouse adds pots, the misters raise the yield, the rain barrel makes watering bigger.

expedition.title: Field trip
expedition.description: Spend dew to bring back a moss you do not have yet. Each trip costs a little more than the last.
expedition.left: no moss left to find | 1 moss left to find | {n} mosses left to find
expedition.complete: Your herbarium is complete: there is no moss left to find.

sources.title: Where dew comes from
sources.note: Each completed task pays its dew once: a base set by its quadrant, plus a greenhouse bonus computed from the yield ({yield} dew per task now). Plant tasks are watered (yield × {multiplier}), Water tasks get half a watering, Trim tasks are misted (yield × 1), Compost and unsorted tasks get no bonus. Streaks and deadlines change XP, not dew.

intro: Your greenhouse never grows dew on its own: every completed task brings some, and the greenhouse adds a bonus on top. Pot mosses to raise the yield, then spend dew on facilities that make each task bring more, or on field trips for new mosses.
